name: @activepieces/piece-flipando
description: Autonomous AI Agents Revolutionizing Compliance with Smart, Adaptive Workflows.

getAllApps.name: getAllApps
getAllApps.description: Retrieves all the applications created by the authenticated user.

aiMetadata.description: Lists the Flipando AI applications owned by the authenticated account (capped at 20 results). Use it to discover available app IDs before running an app or to enumerate what the account can execute. Read-only and idempotent.

runApp.name: runApp
runApp.description: Triggers the execution of a specific Flipando application by ID, initiating a background job for application completion.

application_id.description: ID of the application to be completed.

inputs_data.description: JSON string of key-value pairs for application input variables.

file.description: File to be uploaded, if the application requires documents. Supports PDF, DOCX, images, and other document formats.

file_description.description: Description of the file being uploaded. Required when uploading a file.

aiMetadata.description: Starts a Flipando AI application identified by its numeric application ID, kicking off an asynchronous completion job (retrieve the result later via Get Task). Use it to run a known app with optional JSON input variables and an optional document upload. A file_description is required whenever a file is attached. Not idempotent: each call launches a new run.

getTask.name: getTask
getTask.description: Retrieves the result of a specific Flipando application task by its task ID.

task_id.description: ID of the task to be retrieved.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the current state and result of a Flipando task by its task ID, typically the job returned by Run App or Run App Generator. Use it to poll for or read back the outcome of an asynchronous application run. Read-only and idempotent.

runAppGenerator.name: runAppGenerator
runAppGenerator.description: Triggers the execution of Flipando's Special App Generator, initiating a background job for application completion.

inputs_data.description: JSON string of key-value pairs for application input variables.

is_new_app_private.description: Whether the new app to be created should be private or public.

aiMetadata.description: Runs Flipando's Special App Generator to build a new application, starting an asynchronous completion job (retrieve the result later via Get Task). Use it to create a new app from JSON input variables rather than running an existing one; the is_new_app_private flag controls whether the generated app is private or public. Not idempotent: each call generates a new app.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
